er_v06_c12_b001_01: She comes to the window and checks both ends of the alley, keeping one hand inside her coat.
er_v06_c12_b001_03: She pulls her hand out, pressing a thin disc flat in her palm Lab data disc.
er_v06_c12_b001_04: Drawers locked, cabinets sealed. This was shoved under the lamp mount.
er_v06_c12_b001_05: Mother's habit. She always said drawers are for other people to search.
er_v06_c12_b001_07: It needs a code. I tried all night.
er_v06_c12_b001_08: Her work number, the farm number, my father's... everything I could think of.
er_v06_c12_b001_09: Just before dawn, I typed in my own birthday.
er_v06_c12_b001_11: Something this important, and she used my birthday as the password.
er_v06_c12_b001_13: A pile of records. Shifts, light cycles, materials, accounts. I don't understand half of it.
er_v06_c12_b001_14: One I did understand. Nutrient fruit.
er_v06_c12_b001_15: The kind the ration station hands out. No seeds. You know the ones?
er_v06_c12_b001_16: I know. Seeds come when the top says so.
er_v06_c12_b001_17: She made it seed again. Three rounds of retests. The seeds grow.
er_v06_c12_b001_18: The lower districts could grow their own. No more holding out a hand every month.
er_v06_c12_b001_19: There were letters in there too. From Pastel Company.
er_v06_c12_b001_20: Each one politer than the last. All saying the same thing. Stop the research.
er_v06_c12_b001_21: She answered the last one. Two lines. Said she wouldn't stop.
er_v06_c12_b001_22: Two weeks later, that embezzlement shows up in the books.
er_v06_c12_b001_23: Who else knows about this disc.
er_v06_c12_b001_25: The detective took the money and left. Said it was too hot to touch.
er_v06_c12_b001_26: The lock on my door is broken. People come to check out the room, in and out.
er_v06_c12_b001_27: If I lose it at the dump, I'll never find it.
er_v06_c12_b002_02: Yes. Shifts she wrote down, workers' names, a few accounts left unfinished.
er_v06_c12_b003_01: Leave it with me. There's a lock under the counter.
er_v06_c12_b003_03: She presses her hand on the drive one more time before pushing it overJust for a few days.
er_v06_c12_b003_04: When I figure out what to do with it, I'll come get it.
er_v06_c12_b003_05: I won't look. Won't touch it.
er_v06_c12_b003_06: You said it. Don't go through it while I'm away.
er_v06_c12_b003_08: She steps back and glances at the lock beneath the counter.
er_v06_c13_b001_01: A man plants himself in front of the window, blocking it.
er_v06_c13_b001_02: You get an Upper Tier girl in here a lot.
er_v06_c13_b001_03: Lots of people come in to buy.
er_v06_c13_b001_04: Don't play dumb. The one selling scrap. Her mother's in a cell.
er_v06_c13_b001_05: She's got a drive. Came out of the lab.
er_v06_c13_b001_07: The archive room door was opened. People saw.
er_v06_c13_b001_08: I'm not looking for her. I'm looking for you.
er_v06_c13_b001_10: She won't talk to strangers, but she runs to your place every day.
er_v06_c13_b001_11: You give her a message. Hand over the drive, her mother walks.
er_v06_c13_b001_12: Case dropped, she's released. Simple as that.
er_v06_c13_b001_13: You say let her go, and that's that?
er_v06_c13_b001_14: Not me saying it. Someone else is. I just make the run.
er_v06_c13_b001_15: He digs a stack of money out of his coat and slaps it on the counterThree hundred. Errand money.
er_v06_c13_b001_16: You walk a few steps, open your mouth once, the money's yours.
er_v06_c13_b001_17: If she won't hand it over...
er_v06_c13_b001_18: It's cold in a cell. People get sick. Nobody finds it strange.
er_v06_c13_b001_19: You're using someone locked up to push the price.
er_v06_c13_b001_20: I'm quoting a price. You pawnshop people know all about that.
er_v06_c13_b002_02: He pockets the moneyI've said my piece. You won't take it to her, I'll go say it under her window myself.
er_v06_c13_b003_01: Take the money. I'll pass it on.
er_v06_c13_b003_04: He pockets the moneyYour call. I'm not the one out three hundred.
er_v06_c13_b003_05: I'll come back in three days for an answer.
er_v06_c13_b003_06: The drive comes to you, I pick it up. Her mother gets word the same day.
er_v06_c13_b003_07: Don't get any ideas about the Security Bureau. It's busier over there than you think.
er_v06_c13_b003_09: Done. That girl's got a temper. Soften your tone when you talk her round.
er_v06_c13_b003_10: If she won't listen, you're not the one who pays.
er_v06_c14_b001_01: She comes to the window without a bag this time and first looks at the lock behind the counter.
er_v06_c14_b001_02: You sent word for me. What's so important it has to be today?
er_v06_c14_b001_03: Someone came by. They want that drive.
er_v06_c14_b001_05: A runner from the black market. Says if you hand over the disc, your mother gets out.
er_v06_c14_b001_06: Out? They say out and she's out?
er_v06_c14_b001_07: He says it's not his call. It's his boss's.
er_v06_c14_b001_08: He gave me three hundred for the errand. I didn't take it.
er_v06_c14_b001_09: Three hundred. That's what my mother's worth to them—one errand.
er_v06_c14_b001_10: He also said the cells are cold. If someone gets sick, nobody would think twice.
er_v06_c14_b001_11: She grabs the edge of the counter…He wouldn't dare.
er_v06_c14_b001_12: They would. They made up the accounts. What wouldn't they do?
er_v06_c14_b001_13: How many days did they give you?
er_v06_c14_b001_15: I didn't sleep at all last night.
er_v06_c14_b001_16: If I hand it over, my mother might get out. The research goes back to Pastel, rotting in some drawer.
er_v06_c14_b001_17: It's what she cares about most. She didn't stop even when it meant prison.
er_v06_c14_b001_18: Don't hand it over—post it straight out, let the whole Lower District know the nutrient fruit can produce seeds…
er_v06_c14_b001_19: Then while she's locked in there, she's the last card they can squeeze.
er_v06_c14_b001_20: Hey, you. Tell me. I'm not asking you to decide for me—I just want to hear what move you'd make.
er_v06_c14_b002_01: …Hand it over. Get her out first. The rest can wait.
er_v06_c14_b002_02: Sophia's case dismissed. Subject released. Return to the Upper District prohibited.
er_v06_c14_b002_03: The research is back in their hands. If she asks, I'll tell her myself.
er_v06_c14_b003_01: First go to the Security Department and apply for protective custody. Move her out in the open.
er_v06_c14_b003_02: Once she's protected, hand over the research—publicly.
er_v06_c14_b003_03: The Security Department? They're the ones who locked her up.
er_v06_c14_b003_04: It was that ledger that locked her up. Protective custody is a different form.
er_v06_c14_b003_05: ...But they did let me go in the end.
er_v06_c14_b003_06: Her name's on the care form. If anything happens to her, someone has to sign and answer for it.
er_v06_c14_b003_07: The detective's written statement is still there. He can testify the disc was taken from under the lamp stand and no one touched it.
er_v06_c14_b003_08: I'll make a copy myself first. Before the original goes in, I'll get the contents into the public archive.
er_v06_c14_b003_09: The disc's here. You want it now?
er_v06_c14_b003_10: Now. She takes it and clutches it in her palm.
er_v06_c14_b003_11: If that errand runner comes back, tell them I'm not handing it over. Don't say anything else.
er_v06_c14_b003_12: And... you didn't take the three hundred.
er_v06_c14_b004_01: Post it. Today. Make it so they can't cover it up.
er_v06_c14_b004_02: Detainee Sofia died in custody. Cause under investigation.
er_v06_c14_b004_03: ...It's all posted. She's gone. Don't talk to me. I'll stand here a bit, then leave.
er_v06_c14_b005_01: Detainee Sofia has been transferred to care. Case under review. Visitation by notice.
er_v06_c14_b005_02: Lower District bulletin: hydroponic farm nutrient-fruit seed research has been placed in the public archive.
er_v06_c14_b005_03: The notice is up. Did you see it?
er_v06_c14_b005_05: Transferred to care, under review. I sat outside the Security office all day for those few words.
er_v06_c14_b005_06: The officer who signed it looked at the letter on the disc, and his face changed.
er_v06_c14_b005_07: He said the review takes time. Didn't say how long.
er_v06_c14_b005_09: She's safe. At least, that's what the form says.
er_v06_c14_b005_10: Still no visits. They said wait for notice.
er_v06_c14_b006_02: Direct. Fine. I won't beat around the bush either.
er_v06_c14_b006_03: She doesn't sit, hand on the counterJust tired. Same if I stand.
er_v06_c14_b007_02: ...Just for a while.She pulls up the stool outside the window and sits low
er_v06_c14_b007_03: After the research went up, everyone in line at the ration station was talking.
er_v06_c14_b007_04: An older woman asked me if you can really grow your own. I said yes.
er_v06_c14_b007_05: Then she asked if that meant no more nutrient fruit every day.
er_v06_c14_b007_06: I said no. There'd only be more nutrient fruit. Her face fell right there.
er_v06_c14_b007_08: What would your mother say if she knew?
er_v06_c14_b007_09: She'd pick apart the copy I made and say my handwriting's crooked.
er_v06_c14_b007_10: When I see her, I'll ask why she kept all of this from me.
er_v06_c14_b007_11: I don't want nutrient fruit today. You got anything else to eat? Cheaper.
er_v06_c14_b007_12: Sweet is fine too. Just for today.
er_v06_c14_b008_01: Sweet. Half a month, and I finally get a bite that isn't that skin.
er_v06_c14_b008_02: I'm going back to the junkyard tomorrow. That's it for today.
er_v06_c14_b009_01: You undercharged. Don't think I can't tell.
er_v06_c14_b009_02: …Just this once. Remember—next time I'll bring goods to make up for it.
er_v06_c14_b010_01: That much for this little sweet? You're singling me out today.
er_v06_c14_b010_02: Paid. Next time I'll check the price tags somewhere else first.
er_v06_c14_b011_01: If you don't have any, forget it. I'll go back to nutrient fruit like always.
er_v06_c14_b011_02: She stands, steps back, then pausesI'll come when there's news of the review.
er_v06_c19_b101_return_01: The sky darkens and the streetlights come on one by one. She sits on the crate outside the window, tapping the ground with her toes.
er_v06_c19_b101_return_03: I know. I'm not buying anything.
er_v06_c19_b101_return_04: Mother's home. She can cook her own nutrifruit.
er_v06_c19_b101_return_05: She pulled the pendant out by its cord, gripped it in her palm, then tucked it back.
er_v06_c19_b101_return_06: Hey. I'm telling you something. Don't cut in.
er_v06_c19_b101_return_07: When I first came down here, I thought every pawnshop in the lower district was the same.
er_v06_c19_b101_return_08: That other place kept haggling me down and docking the purity. When they shorted me a few credits, I didn't come to you to make it up.
er_v06_c19_b101_return_09: But I keep coming here. Not because it's cheap. It isn't cheap.
er_v06_c19_b101_return_10: What you did for my mother — I haven't forgotten.
er_v06_c19_b101_return_11: Don't think I'm paying off a debt.
er_v06_c19_b101_return_13: That's it. Do what you want.
